7415.title: Account shell omitted from terminal fallback
7415.rootCauseOneLine: The Unix terminal resolver omits the account shell, so an absent or unusable SHELL selects a hardcoded executable instead.
7415.proposedFix: Try the operating-system account shell after SHELL and before hardcoded candidates, preserving executable checks, lookup-failure fallback, and Windows behavior.
7415.caveats: Repeated on Linux through the real resolver and PTY launch boundary with an OS-account mock; no live macOS launchd or fish integration was run. Test patch is inline per report repository policy.
